title: Quentin and the Safehouse
author: Hazel Amberdale
blurb: Rosalind Marchetti, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must trade the one secret worth killing for before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
